title: tool_doswin: warn user that path is too long to be sanitized
body:
- Treat SANITIZE_ERR_INVALID_PATH in the calling function as CURLE_BAD_FUNCTION_ARGUMENT.

- Warn via warnf with the reason that SANITIZE_ERR_INVALID_PATH is returned.

SANITIZE_ERR_ codes are not mapped directly to CURLE_ error codes which may have led to some confusion in certain cases so this change is an attempt to mitigate that.

Prior to this change some calling functions returned CURLE_URL_MALFORMAT for SANITIZE_ERR_INVALID_PATH even though the URL was not malformatted.

Bug: https://github.com/curl/curl/pull/20113/changes#r2652697794
Reported-by: Viktor Szakats

Closes #xxxxx
